prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1366; do not mention it.)
text: This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Kindly provide written confirmation of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with the declarations page and any applicable excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dashcam or telematics records, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any communications with your insured or other parties. Destruction or alteration of such materials could prejudice our client's claim. We look forward to your prompt written response so that we may evaluate the claim appropriately.
